Feature release: howtui can now use your own API keys and local models besides Sign in with ChatGPT. Nothing changes if
you keep using ChatGPT; your sign-in, model choice and shell integration stay as they are.

## What's new since `v0.1.2`

- **Use your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible server.** Save a key with
  `howtui auth set-key openai` (nothing is shown while you type or paste; piping it in works too), or set
  `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY`. Keys live in the OS credential store and are never printed,
  logged or read from the config file; `howtui auth status` shows only where each key comes from. Default models:
  `gpt-6-astra`, `claude-opus-5-5`, `gemini-3.8-flash`. See
  [Agents and API keys](https://github.com/hungryZoo/howtui#agents-and-api-keys).
- **Local models through Ollama and llama.cpp `llama-server`.** Start the server yourself, then run
  `howtui --provider ollama` or `--provider llama_server`; howtui never downloads or starts models. We recommend Gemma 4
  E4B (`gemma4:e4b-it-qat`): it scored highest of 12 small models we measured on CPU, though still clearly below the
  ChatGPT models, so read local suggestions carefully. If the server is not running you get the address it tried and
  exit code 6. See [Local models](https://github.com/hungryZoo/howtui#local-models) and the
  [comparison](https://github.com/hungryZoo/howtui/blob/main/docs/research/local-llm-eval.md).
- **Switch agents in Settings.** Ctrl+O now lists ChatGPT, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI compatible, Ollama and
  llama-server with what each needs (sign-in, key, address). Pick one with Enter or a click; the choice is kept for next
  time and the conversation carries over. `--provider` picks an agent for one run, `provider.default` in the config sets
  the default.
- **More danger warnings.** Bulk permission changes through `find ... -exec chmod`, `chmod` on `/`, `kill` on a list of
  PIDs from `$(...)`, `kill 1`, and Docker data removal (`docker system prune`, `docker volume prune`) are now flagged.
  These came up while testing local models. howtui still never runs commands.
- `howtui doctor` checks the agent you use: key source for API agents, and server type, version, loading state and model
  for local servers.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/howtui/main/scripts/install.sh | sh     # Linux, macOS
```

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/howtui/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex           # Windows
```

Already on 0.1.2: press Enter on the `[v0.2.0 available]` note, or run `howtui --update`. Release archives for all seven
targets are attached below.

## Verify

`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing` and `gh attestation verify <file> --repo hungryZoo/howtui`.
Binaries are not code-signed or notarized.
